evidence.quote: live since friday on base. 7 coinbase tokenized stocks, borrow usdc against them.

chainlink's tokenized equity feeds publish sunday evening to friday evening et. outside that window the feed holds friday's close. no heartbeat off hours. the contract still answers you, it just answers with a stale number.
so the token keeps trading on aerodrome all weekend while aave values it at friday close.
- start at half the max ltv. 79% available does not mean 79% used
- skip any ticker with earnings before your next check in
- friday: deleverage before the close, not after
- monday: if the stock gapped down 8% overnight, your ltv moves 8% in a single print
there's no slow bleed into liquidation here. it arrives as a jump.
